{{Top|leg}}
'''Hatchmate''' was a term used by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to describe other troopers who were born, or "hatched", in the same [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] batch on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Mag (clone trooper)|Mag]] referred to [[Flanker]] as a "hatchmate" of [[Shiv (clone trooper)|Shiv]] while they were stationed on [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]]. [[Sev/Legends|Sev]] and [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]] were hatchmates.

Hatchmate was used as a familial term by the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabels]] of [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]] to refer to blood relatives of their [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
